Description
: Explore Earth's ancient past with this 12-piece Fossil Collection Kit, perfect for science enthusiasts and collectors alike. Each fossil is individually bagged and accompanied by an educational card describing its origin and significance, including gastropods, pelycopods, horn coral, crinoid stems, brachiopods, trilobites, dinosaur bone, ammonites, fossil wood, algae, and shark teeth. The set includes a colorful timeline card mapping major periods of prehistoric life, making it a valuable educational tool. Ideal for students, teachers, or hobbyists, these fossils offer hands-on learning about natural history and paleontology. All items shown are included, and each fossil appears in its own clear, labeled packet for easy viewing and storage. The set is presented in good visible condition, with all key contents intact and readable. Delight in the tactile experience of real fossils and enrich your educational collection or science display with this fascinating assortment.
This is a pre-owned item donated to Goodwill of Northern Michigan.
